title: Threads — Static and Animated Logotype
summary: A logotype redesign for a youth clothing retailer, translating the idea of thread and weaving into a continuous graphic mark and animated identity.
meta: Static logotype, woven graphic elements, animated logotype

items.label: Project
items.text: This project redesigns the logotype for Threads, a youth-oriented clothing retailer. The identity explores the idea of connection through continuous, thread-like strokes that reference the brand name and the physical process of weaving. The project extends the static logo into motion, showing how an identity can develop across still and animated applications.

items.label: Creative direction
items.text: The primary mark uses continuous strokes to suggest a connected thread. Secondary woven strokes reinforce the textile reference and give the identity a more distinctive visual character, connecting the name, the clothing context, and the graphic form without relying on an overly literal illustration.

items.label: Design approach
items.text: The static logotype establishes the identity’s core shape and proportions. The animated version develops the same concept through movement, using the continuous-thread idea as the foundation for the motion treatment and keeping the identity recognizable across both versions.
